_readme: Audits of upcoming records against the organizers' own material. An audit counts a record wrong once if any action-critical field (dates, format, place, abstract call or deadline, eligibility) disagreed with the organizer. The latest audit's share right is the accuracy term of the Reliability Index; earlier audits give its reading from history (site/AI-HANDOFF.md §3.4). Add each new audit with its date, method and counts; never remove one.

audits.method: Every upcoming record re-derived from organizer material without the stored values (AI agents; sources that block cloud readers or publish dates only in images were read in a browser)
Independent review of the live build's code, data and interface by a second AI model family (ChatGPT)

Blind random sample of 40 upcoming records the latest check had confirmed, each re-derived from the organizer's own pages by AI agents that never saw the stored values; 35 could be assessed. All 35 dates were right; 7 abstract calls and 1 host city were not
